docs: Submission of GOPA, Empanelment Letters and Bank Mandate Forms through the Vendor Login Portal of ERP by Private FM Stations-reg | .15 MB 28-10-2026
items.doc_text:
Government of India 
Ministry of Information & Broadcasting 
Central Bureau of Communication 
Soochna Bhawan, New Delhi 
File No: AV/Radio/2025-26/Misc-Part (1) Dated: 27.10.2026 
ADVISORY 
Subject: Submission of GOPA, Empanelment Letters and Bank Mandate Forms 
through the Vendor Login Portal of ERP by Private FM Stations-reg 
CBC is updating the records of all empanelled Private FM stations in its ERP system. 
In this regard, all empanelled Private FM stations are required to submit the following 
documents through the Vendor Login Portal of the CBC ERP: 
(i) Grant of Permission Agreement (GOPA) 
(ii) Empanelment Letter issued by CBC 
(iii) Bank Mandate Form 
(iv) Ownership Details (latest) 
2. The documents may be uploaded using the existing vendor login credentials during the 
period 28.10.2026–06.11.2026 (10 days). 
3. No fee is payable for this submission. 
4. All empanelled Private FM stations shall complete the submission within the stipulated time. 
5. This issues with the approval of the Competent Authority. 
 
(Sri Sai Vempati) 
Deputy Director (AV) 
Central Bureau of Communication 
To 
1. Sr. Project Manager (BECIL) for uploading on website. 
2. DD (OL) for translation.
